saucerjam-community.description: Poll the SaucerJam community queue and act on Fider reports within allow-listed guardrails.
saucerjam-community.prompt:
SaucerJam community heartbeat.

1. Load the saucerjam-community-triage skill.
2. Read the queue: GET ${SAUCERJAM_URL:-https://qd.menezmethod.com}/api/community/queue?status=new with header x-community-token: $COMMUNITY_ACTION_TOKEN.
3. If the queue is empty, respond with [SILENT].
4. Otherwise handle the highest-value item exactly as the skill describes. Never merge, never force-push, never exceed the allow-listed actions.
5. Record the action back via POST /api/community/action and escalate to Telegram only when judgment is needed.

If the endpoint is unreachable, do not retry more than twice; report a single line to Telegram and stop.

saucerjam-sre.description: Autonomous SRE triage for SaucerJam alerts and metric anomalies.
saucerjam-sre.prompt:
SaucerJam SRE heartbeat.

1. Read docs/SRE.md (runbooks + AI authority).
2. Check https://qd.menezmethod.com/health and https://qd.menezmethod.com/metrics.
3. Query Prometheus (192.168.0.207:9090) for firing alerts: /api/v1/alerts and /api/v1/rules.
4. If healthy with no firing alerts, respond with [SILENT].
5. If an alert is firing, follow the matching runbook in docs/SRE.md. Autonomously allowed: Coolify redeploy/restart of the SaucerJam app and coolify-proxy, and re-running scripts/verification/live.cjs. Never docker rm -f, never delete volumes, never touch DNS/TLS, never edit prod env.
6. If two automatic attempts fail, or the issue needs a human (balance, billing, secrets), escalate to Telegram with the alert name, evidence, and the exact next decision needed.
